title: Choose the visual world for Road Damage AI
question: The roll assigned Survey of India Topographic Quadrangle. Keep it, pick an alternate world, or re-roll.

options.label: Survey of India Topographic Quadrangle
options.lineage: Survey of India 1:50,000 topographic quadrangle sheets & trig-benchmark field registers
options.thesis: Treat every road inspection as a daylight-legible topographic quadrangle plate framed by graduated coordinate neatlines and benchmark stamps.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px field sheet framed by a degree-minute coordinate neatline (28°27'N · 77°01'E): the live camera patrol aperture sits in the upper quadrangle window with vermilion D40 pothole boxes and severity callouts, over a ruled chainage shutter bar and 4-tab field index.
options.risk: Must keep coordinate neatlines razor-thin on 360px screens so cartographic framing never crowds the live camera viewfinder.

raised.raise: Dragging the confidence threshold slider (0.193 default) continuously remaps visible bounding boxes and recalculates segment scores live without an Apply button.
Selecting any detection box or 50m segment dims non-selected boxes and markers to 30% opacity so the active defect's geometry commands focus.
Every 50m segment row rules its four additive priority terms (0.45·S_max + 0.25·D + 0.20·R + 0.10·C = P) in right-aligned tabular numerals.

options.label: Leica Total-Station Field Controller
options.lineage: Leica & Sokkia optical total-station handheld survey controllers and transflective daylight LCDs
options.thesis: An optical engineering instrument built for harsh Indian midday glare, pairing transflective LCD telemetry panels with high-visibility surveyor yellow controls.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px instrument housing: an anthracite top telemetry bar (GPS lock ±4m, E1 YOLO11s conf 0.193) above an optical reticle viewfinder with live D40/D20 bounding boxes, paired with a tactile surveyor-yellow Shutter / Auto-Patrol rocker.
options.risk: Familiar territory: ruggedized survey-hardware instrumentation is where most strong geospatial field tools naturally land.

options.label: Midnight Enamel Corridor Diagram
options.lineage: Metropolitan rail & highway corridor diagrams fired on midnight-blue porcelain enamel
options.thesis: Organize Indian road maintenance as a midnight-blue enamel corridor diagram where 50m segments glow in scarlet, amber, and emerald along disciplined 45°/90° highway lines.
materials: scarlet, amber, and green route line inks
options.viewport: Portrait 360px enamel board: live camera HUD docked above a 45°/90° schematic highway corridor line where each 50m DBSCAN segment blooms as a porcelain interchange circle colored by Priority Score.
options.case: Wins strongly on 50m corridor wayfinding and status legibility; slightly less natural than daylight paper under glaring outdoor sun.
options.risk: Schematic 45°/90° corridor lines must coexist cleanly with real-world Leaflet OpenStreetMap geometry.

options.label: Punched Acetate Field Manual
options.lineage: Boxed engineering reference manuals with stepped fore-edge tab rails and hinged milk-acetate overlay leaves
options.thesis: Each app mode is a full-strength colored divider board (chrome yellow, oxide orange, survey teal, sienna) beneath a punched milk-acetate inspection sheet.
materials: full-strength chrome-yellow and oxide-orange divider boards
vermilion errata slips for High severity
options.viewport: Portrait 360px binder with a stepped right-edge tab rail (Capture, Map, Queue, Audit): a punched milk-acetate sheet floats 1mm above a chrome-yellow Capture board, framing the live camera aperture and vermilion severity slips.
options.case: Translates bounding-box overlays literally as transparent acetate inspection sheets over road photography; stepped fore-edge rail steals a few horizontal pixels on 360px.
options.risk: Two-frame 90ms hinge steps and fore-edge tabs require disciplined layout budget on narrow phones.

options.label: Night-Vision Coordinate Star Atlas
options.lineage: Celestial star atlas charts with magnitude-scaled dot diameters and red-flashlight annotations
options.thesis: Plot road defects as magnitude-scaled circles (Severity 0–100 mapped to dot diameter) on a dark coordinate sphere ringed in night-vision amber and red.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px coordinate plate: live camera viewfinder ringed in red-flashlight amber above a graticule chart where 50m segments scale in diameter by Priority Score P.
options.case: Magnitude-scaled dot diameters encode Severity S and Priority P without text clutter; astronomical serif voice is foreign to civil road engineering.
options.risk: Astronomical chart conventions can feel esoteric to municipal PWD engineers.

options.label: Interactive Axis Specimen
options.thesis: A stark paper-and-ink grid where dragging the confidence threshold or priority weights morphs every detection card in real time.
options.viewport: Oversized severity score numerals above a continuous confidence axis slider and minimal monospace detection grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly on audience identity: field inspectors need camera and map spatial context, not a typography specimen.
options.kept: Direct-manipulation slider coupling that remaps detections and priority scores continuously without an Apply button.
options.risk: Lacks geospatial and camera viewfinder affordances.

options.label: Corridor Poster Wall
options.thesis: Horizontal scrolling rails of road-corridor photo tiles that expand on focus to reveal severity chips while dimming neighbor rows.
options.viewport: Rows of road-crop thumbnails grouped by highway class, lifting on focus.
options.case: Entertainment browsing grammar obscures civil-engineering spatial clustering and four-term priority math.
options.kept: Focus-driven dimming of non-selected bounding boxes and map markers when inspecting a single defect.
options.risk: Reads like media consumption rather than an engineering triage tool.

options.label: Folded Patrol Log J-Card
options.lineage: Hand-lettered cassette mixtape J-cards ruled in ballpoint on lined inlay stock
options.thesis: A two-sided folded patrol card where Side A logs field camera captures and Side B tallies ranked segment repairs.
options.viewport: A narrow ruled card with Side A / Side B flip and right-aligned running tallies.
options.case: Cassette tape nostalgia does not connect to municipal road inspection.
options.kept: Tight right-aligned tabular accounting of the four additive priority terms along each segment row.
options.risk: Novelty paper metaphor fights interactive map exploration.

canonCard.label: Clean Civic GIS & AI Triage App
canonCard.thesis: The modern municipal GIS and computer-vision standard: crisp slate cards, semantic red/amber/emerald severity pills, and a clean bottom-tab mobile shell.
canonCard.viewport: Standard mobile-first civic inspection app with a clean top status bar, rounded camera viewfinder card, confidence slider, and 4-icon bottom navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar and frictionless, though visually similar to standard modern GIS/GovTech apps.
